source_kind_detail: issuer-hosted XLSX (all SPDR US ETFs historical distributions, single sheet 'dividend'), filtered to TICKER == SPY
fetch_method: python requests GET inside the default sandbox (no sandbox override needed); Content-Type application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet; 575400 bytes
parsing_notes: Workbook has one sheet ('dividend') with 13227 data rows covering 176 SPDR US ETF tickers; every cell is stored as a text string (dates MM/DD/YYYY, amounts as decimal strings). Selected the 135 rows with TICKER == 'SPY' (single CUSIP 78462F103, FREQUENCY 'Quarterly' on every row). amount = DIVIDEND ($) + SHORT TERM CAPITAL GAIN ($) + LONG TERM CAPITAL GAIN ($) per share (blank treated as 0). Capital-gain columns are blank or 0.000000 on every SPY row except one: ex 1996-12-20: dividend 0.286810 + STCG 0.080000 + LTCG 0.040000 = 0.406810. (That 1996-12-20 row is the regular Q4 1996 distribution with a cash capital-gain component; its CSV amount is the 0.406810 total.) Separately, ex 2004-11-15 (pay 2004-12-02, dividend 0.351020, no capital gains) is a fifth 2004 distribution 32 days before the regular 2004-12-17 ex-date; it is kept as a cash distribution as given by the issuer. No duplicate ex-dates, so no cross-row summing occurred. No amount <= 0. pay_date = PAYABLE DATE; RECORD DATE is in the raw file but not carried into the CSV. Parsed with zipfile + xml.etree (openpyxl not installed in the venv) then pandas. Last ex-date in source is 2026-06-18 (paid 2026-07-31), which is within the requested window ending 2026-07-17; no rows beyond the cutoff existed, so no truncation applied. Cadence check: 4 ex-dates per calendar year 1993-2025 (5 in 2004 due to the extra 2004-11-15 record), 2 in 2026; no missing quarters detected.
